activity_summary: On the bridge Judith said you walk like your father, and she showed you. Hamnet asked the miles and kept a hundred. Susanna looked at your feet and said nothing. Richard took the pack at the town end. The flat parcel in the oilcloth rides on top.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered the miles, and gave the pack over.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Took a hundred, and did not take the pack.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at your feet and said nothing.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the pack at the town end, and put the flat parcel on top.

facets.activity: Came over the bridge and let Richard take the pack
